reason: My order book is full for months, so a missed call barely costs me anything. Paying 990 euros plus 149 a month to collect even more enquiries I can't take on makes no sense right now.
objection: I don't need more leads, I need fewer interruptions, and I don't want to mess with my phone and call forwarding for something that solves a problem I don't really have. On top of that it's a brand-new company with no customers, and I'm not handing my customer calls to them.
would_change_my_mind: If it filtered and politely put off non-urgent enquiries for me, so it saved my office time instead of creating more callbacks, at a much lower price with no setup fee.
